Work classically and induct on the explicit natural index `n`, generalizing the ambient type and all rooted datum that depend on it.  Thus the successor induction hypothesis is universally available for any finite decidable child-component type whose cardinality is bounded by `n`; do not invoke `capacity_pos_lt_one`.

For `n = 0`, the hypothesis `Fintype.card V ≤ 0` contradicts the inhabited root type: `Fintype.card_pos_iff` applied to `⟨ρ⟩` gives `0 < Fintype.card V`.

For the successor `n + 1`, retain `hAdm` and destruct a copy as `⟨hG, hPos, hTwo, hCount⟩`; put `S := rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ`.  For each `c ∈ S`, set `C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c` with the existing local Fintype and decidable-adjacency conventions.  The theorem `rootedChildComponent_card_lt G hG ρ ρ c hc` and the ambient bound give `Fintype.card C ≤ n`.  The inherited witness from `IsAdmissibleRootedTree_rootedChildComponent G w ρ ρ c hG hc hAdm` lets the ordinary induction hypothesis prove
`rootedCapacity C.toSimpleGraph (fun x : C => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c) < 1`.

Split on `S.Nonempty`.  In the nonempty case, unfold `rootedChildCapacitySum` solely to expose this finite family, aligning its local instances with the induction instances by proof irrelevance.  `Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty` gives
`rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ < (S.card : ℚ)`.
Unfold `rootedChildCount` in `hCount ρ` and cast to `ℚ`, obtaining `(S.card : ℚ) + 1 ≤ w ρ`.  Hence the denominator
`(w ρ : ℚ) - rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ` is strictly greater than one.  Rewrite by `rootedCapacity_recursion G hG w ρ hAdm` and use `div_lt_one` to conclude the desired upper bound.

If `S` is empty, the defined child-capacity sum is zero.  Casting `hTwo ρ : (2 : ℤ) ≤ w ρ` shows the same denominator is greater than one, so the same recursion rewrite and `div_lt_one` finish.  This is the child-free/base branch of the source’s tree-size induction.  No extra admissibility, nonzero-denominator, or replacement-capacity assumption is introduced; `rootedCapacity_pos` is not needed because both branches establish the stronger denominator estimate directly.

-- lean-constellation: managed-imports-begin
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Prelude
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.IsAdmissibleRootedTree
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedCapacity
-- lean-constellation: managed-imports-end

-- lean-constellation: declaration-source-begin

/--
# lean-constellation target: `rootedCapacity_lt_one_of_card_le`

For every natural number `n`, every finite decidable vertex type, graph `G` with decidable
adjacency, integer weight `w`, root `ρ`, and admissibility witness `hAdm : IsAdmissibleRootedTree G
w ρ`, if
```
Fintype.card V ≤ n,
```
then the existing rational capacity satisfies
```
rootedCapacity G w ρ < 1.
```

The theorem is private and is indexed by the explicit natural upper bound `n`, with all rooted-tree
data universally quantified beneath that index. It preserves the existing component, root, weight,
capacity, and rational total-inverse semantics, adds no stronger admissibility or denominator
hypothesis, and does not invoke the public theorem `capacity_pos_lt_one`. It is oriented to provide
precisely the upper half of that public interface after ordinary induction on `n`.

  `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedCapacity`
-/
